public_body: Fall River Zoning Board Of Appeals
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the July 17, 2025 Rock Street hearing was accessible despite a crowded room, since open seats existed and attendees could see and hear. The AG issued a reminder about accessibility and crowd accommodation, not an order.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the July 17, 2025 meeting was not accessible because the room could not accommodate all attendees.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the July 17, 2025, meeting was accessible, and thus the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged certain members of the public could not hear the Board's discussions at the July 17, 2025 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The video recording and screen shots show a crowded room with many attendees standing at the back of the room but does not clearly demonstrate that the meeting was inaccessible to members of the public, or that members of the public could not see and hear the proceedings.
